notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes: [p]The Thieves Guild questline has been fully implemented.  All that is left to do now are general housekeeping, one-off minor quests and dialogs to build immersion in the game, and then a demo will be released.[/p]

notes.title: Mage's Guild Questline
notes.notes: [p]Mage's Guild questline has been completed and implemented. [/p]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes: [p]The complete Crimson Shield (Warrior's Guild) questline has been completed and implemented into the game! [/p]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes: [p]All 3 separate endings are now completed! The 'good' ending also has an adaptive scene that will be different depending on whether you complete a set of side quests or not. I'm now working on adding in the remaining guild questlines and side-quests from the Nothmere villagers.[/p]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes: [p]This evening I finished scripting Ending #2, and am now beginning Ending #1, the "good" ending. Once the three endings are complete, I will be focusing on the guild progression for all 3 guilds, and adding some of the final one-off side quests from the townsfolk in Nothmere.[/p]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes: This weekend I finished scripting Ending #3 (the “bad” ending), and am now knee-deep in Ending #2, the “mediocre” ending. Once done with the endings, I will be focusing on the guild progression for all 3 guilds, and adding some of the final one-off side quests from the townsfolk in Nothmere.
